policies.title: Copyright Act, 1957 and publisher licence terms for e-resources
policies.obligation: Use of e-journals, e-books and databases is limited by licence: only authorised users, simultaneous-user limits, download and print limits, and no systematic bulk downloading. Remote access must be through authentication.
policies.control: Authenticate users, enforce simultaneous-user and download limits per licence, detect bulk downloading and keep usage statistics.

policies.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
policies.obligation: Processing of digital personal data needs a lawful purpose, notice and consent. Collect only data necessary for the stated purpose, keep it only as long as needed, apply reasonable security safeguards, report personal data breaches, and let individuals access, correct and erase their data. Extra care applies to children's data.
policies.control: Record consent and purpose, minimise collected fields, define retention and deletion schedules, mask personal data in logs and exports, support access/correction/erasure requests, and maintain a breach-response procedure.

escalations: Policy/regulatory interpretation must be approved by the compliance or legal officer.

policies.obligation: Applications should use strong authentication, secure session management, input validation, least privilege, secure logging and protection of APIs against injection.
policies.control: Single sign-on or multi-factor authentication for staff, session timeout, input validation and secure API design.

policies.title: Information Technology Act, 2000 and institutional IT security policy
policies.source: Government of India / University IT policy
policies.obligation: Unauthorised access to computer systems and data is an offence. Institutions are expected to apply reasonable security practices, restrict access by role, encrypt sensitive data and report cyber security incidents as required.
policies.control: Role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, access logging, and an incident-reporting procedure.
